title: Classic Margherita Pizza
summary: A traditional Italian pizza with fresh mozzarella, basil, and tomato sauce
instructions:
1. Prepare the dough
2. Add tomato sauce
3. Add mozzarella
4. Bake at 450°F for 15 minutes

title: Grilled Chicken Salad
summary: Healthy grilled chicken salad with mixed greens and vinaigrette
instructions:
1. Grill chicken breast
2. Mix salad greens
3. Add grilled chicken
4. Dress with vinaigrette

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
summary: Classic homemade chocolate chip cookies with crispy edges and chewy centers
instructions:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Add eggs and vanilla
4. Bake at 375°F for 10-12 minutes
